item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena pours all the water from a tall, narrow bottle into a short, wide jug. The jug is only half full, while the bottle was completely full.

What should Meena conclude about the volume of the water?

options.A: The volume of water decreased because the jug is only half full.
options.B: The volume of water stayed the same because the same water now occupies a different-shaped space.
options.C: The volume of water increased because the jug is wider than the bottle.
options.D: The volume of water became equal to the full capacity of the jug.
